text: Figure 7.1: Overview of the definition of Life Cycles For each AUTOSAR element of type "Referrable" a LifeCycleInfoSet can be given which references LifeCycleInfo elements for each LifeCycleState modification combined with a LifeCyclePeriod information. This can be used to document the history of an AUTOSAR element. The Life Cycle information of elements is available in the .arxml files generated at: • AUTOSAR_MOD_GeneralDefinition_LifeCycle.arxml: Definition of a life cycle state that is applicable globally in the AUTOSAR project and also used in the Basic SW area (LifeCycleStateDefinitionGroup).
